title: Black and white musicians' unions in New York and elsewhere
summary: Discussion of separate and mixed union locals in New York, Chicago and Brooklyn.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: It's only one up there. It's only one.
It's only one in New York, huh? Sure, then.

Well, the reason I was in doubt about it is because a friend of mine told me, now look, I want you to go to the colored union when you're up there. You hear? If you have any trouble getting in the white union up there, go to the colored union up there. Yeah. And he said... They're all mixed up. They might have too long. This fellow was evidently mixed up. Yeah. They might have two locals. I don't know what else.
Up in New York, they do in Chicago, they have two.
